title: Fix MaintenanceAgentService.RunAsync no run-exclusivity guard
description:
Fix MaintenanceAgentService.RunAsync no run-exclusivity guard (Council-refined)

Source: audits/swarm-audit-synthesis-26-07-26.md

Problem: MaintenanceAgentService may start overlapping runs; add distributed/generic run-exclusivity (mutex) to prevent concurrent runs.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add mutex by process (e.g., named Mutex) and cooperative lock for multi-process via DB row lock or lease
- Add tests simulating overlapping starts demonstrating one run wins and others exit gracefully

Effort: 4-8h
